column4: Hyprland. Terminals, browser, file managers, the launcher, the hub and the cheatsheets. SUPER is the main modifier.

Hyprland. One grammar: the modifier picks the layer, h j k l the direction. SUPER focuses, SUPER+SHIFT moves or swaps, SUPER+CTRL resizes (repeats while held), SUPER+ALT switches group tabs and workspaces. Resize mode (SUPER+CTRL+R) keeps h j k l active until any other key.
Hyprland. A group stacks windows as tabs in one tile.
Hyprland. 20 workspaces (SUPER = 1-10, SUPER+ALT = 11-20, add SHIFT to move the window there), a scratch workspace and monitor moves.
Hyprland. Frozen = the screen stops at the key press and you select on the still image.
Hyprland. Clipboard history, emoji, snippets and the Bitwarden pickers (copied secrets are cleared after 30 s).
Hyprland. Volume, microphones, media keys and brightness of the focused monitor.
Hyprland. Dunst: dismiss, history, do-not-disturb and the actions of the visible notification.
Hyprland. Lock, power, update, idle, night light, the bar and the network pickers.
Hyprland. wl-kbptr hint click and drag, plus the mouse submap (SUPER+ALT+M) where hjkl move the pointer; any key not listed leaves it.
Hyprland binds that no classification rule claims yet (add a rule to rules.tsv).
One-shot which-key popup generated from the hub rows: press SUPER+; then the group key, then the item key. The popup lists every option, so you can read as you go. Keys work on the ua and ru layouts.

tmux, read from a private server that loads tmux.conf (notes are the -N text of each bind). The prefix is Ctrl+Space. Status badges: PREFIX yellow, COPY blue, ZOOM purple, SYNC red; a red bell marks a background window that needs attention.
The unchanged default prefix keys that tmux documents (list-keys -N). Everything in the block above overrides or extends them.
zsh vi-mode (Esc = NORMAL, cursor beam = INSERT, block = NORMAL; [I] [N] [V] in the prompt). Read with bindkey from an interactive zsh; vi motions and operators are the standard ones.
Functions of .zshrc that carry a comment, plus the commands of this setup.
Every alias of .zshrc with what it expands to.
Neovim (NvChad fork), dumped headless from the live mappings that carry a desc. Space is the leader; which-key shows the options after a moment.
Telescope: files, grep, buffers, help, keymaps.
LazyGit, Telescope git pickers and diffview.
Definitions, references, actions, rename, format, symbols and diagnostics.
DAP (breakpoints, stepping, REPL).
Diagnostics, quickfix, symbols and todos lists.
Test runner and terminal splits.
Buffer closing and working directory moves.
auto-session: load, search, delete.
Lazy, Mason and plugin updates.
File tree, Yazi, save, quit and the other single-key leader mappings.
Mappings outside the leader: jumps, windows, comments, flash, diagnostics navigation.

Every menu except the app launcher is one Telescope-like modal list (fzf-menu, ~/.config/fzf/vimfzf.sh) in a floating ghostty, or in the current terminal. A second press of the bind closes the open menu; the previously focused window gets the focus back. Cyrillic (ua/ru) twins of every NORMAL key are generated.
Menu-specific keys keep the Alt+ form (works in both modes) and get a NORMAL letter; the header of each menu lists them.
Programs that read characters themselves, so they have no Cyrillic twins.

Two bars per monitor: compact and full (SUPER+B switches, SUPER+CTRL+B hides). Click grammar of every module: L main action (a switch toggles), R menu or alternative, M quick binary action, scroll adjusts the value. Read from the tooltip hints of modules.jsonc and the bar scripts.
apps/telegram/shortcuts-custom.json (needs one Telegram restart).
Vimium C defaults stay; the ua/ru layouts get the same keys through mapKey. Import browsers/vimium-c.json once.

Obsidian's Vim key bindings plus the community plugin Vimrc Support reading apps/obsidian/obsidian.vimrc (Space is the leader, habits of the nvim config). The ua/ru layouts get explicit nmap/vmap twins (layout.py gen obsidian). apps/obsidian/apply.sh installs the pinned plugin (plugins.tsv), enables it and links the vimrc into the vault; restart Obsidian.
greetd + Quickshell greeter. Letters are matched by physical key, so everything works on the ua and ru layouts (Caps switches us / ua / ru; the layout pill turns yellow when it is not US).
Every bind works while the Ukrainian or Russian layout is active. One physical-key map (.config/layout/keymap.tsv) feeds layout.py, which writes the per-tool files; never type Cyrillic twins by hand.

column4: Every interactive surface that still lacks vim keys or Cyrillic twins, and why. Keys = the surface, Action = what to use instead, Context = what is missing. Everything else in this document has both.
